headline: Magic Carpet now flies itself — WATCH seats the carpet's own wizard brain
lede: Batch 6 of the WATCH rollout (#1637): press Y in Magic Carpet and the game's own autopilot takes the carpet — the same closed-loop brain that the attract demo shows and that carpetcheck proves wins all three worlds across 60 seeds. Any key or tap hands the wheel straight back to you, exactly where the pilot left it.

notes.text: Magic Carpet joins WATCH: Y seats autopilot(gs), re-deciding from live state every tick — pearls, grimoires, wizard duels, banking the vault, veiling when hurt. Coverage: 37 of 80 arcade routes now carry an honest guide.

Honesty gates moved: /magic-carpet left the no-guide list (a solver really drives it now); DOS/IF titles stay pinned no-guide. A mutant seat wired to nothing turns the new watchcheck pilot red on yaw and vault signals — restored green before merge.

Takeover is lossless: the steer key that unseats the pilot still steers, and the carpet's bank, pitch and boost streaks follow the pilot's inputs while watching — the picture always matches the route being flown.

This box's system DNS and certificate store died mid-session; a raw-DNS CONNECT proxy plus a Node gh shim (already headed into the repo via #1691) kept the lane moving. Notes in STATE.md for the next session.
